required_observations: host executable identity, version, package digest and dependency inventory
observed OpenFX API version and supported suite inventory
plugin binary immutable digest, allowlist decision, license, SBOM, signature or exception receipt and malware/behavior scan
content-addressed golden input, declared effect identifier, parameters, frame range and timebase
explicit input, working and output color spaces plus OCIO configuration digest
requested and observed CPU or accelerator backend identity
HRB lease with accelerator UUID and PCI BDF for accelerator execution
output artifact SHA-256, per-frame checksums and finite pixel/alpha QC
network-denied isolated worker lifecycle, crash containment and resource envelope
source project unchanged, staged-output promotion and rollback/unload receipt
promotion_rule: Reference CI and typed-receipt validation cannot promote current-host runtime. Production admission requires a fresh real render receipt satisfying every required observation.
